title: US-Iran Military Clash in Strait of Hormuz Amid Ongoing Peace Negotiations
detail: Despite ongoing US-Iran peace negotiations, military tensions escalated sharply in the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian forces launched missiles, drones, and small-boat attacks on three US warships transiting the strait; the US responded with strikes on Iranian military sites at Bandar Abbas and Qeshm Island. The following day (May 8), US forces fired on and disabled two Iranian oil tankers. Iran's Foreign Ministry condemned 'the aggressive action by the terrorist US military' against the oil tankers. President Trump described the US strikes as a 'love tap' and insisted the ceasefire remained in effect. Iran characterized the episode as US aggression that endangered the peace process. Negotiations continued despite the exchanges, with Trump reporting 'very good talks' within 24 hours of the military clash.
